description:
More Combat Terrain Effects

About

This mod adds custom combat effect to most terrain that did not have an effect previously, as well as making campaign objectives useful in-combat.

Examples include...

Magnetic Field: Reduces weapon range, fighter range, jams guided missiles, and more.Slipstream: Forces SO on all ships, fighters, and missiles. Yes, missiles.Hyperspace Storm: Spawns nebula clouds that strike nearby ships with high EMP lightning. Very dangerous.Sensor Array: Increases friendly fleet weapon range, depending on the fleet's distance to the sensor array.

More exist, and can be discovered in-game.

All effects follow the same rules (for the most part) as their campaign counterparts! Ex. hyperstorms strike you more often if you have a lot of mass or if you're moving fast. Conversely, moving slowly enough will prevent you from being struck at all.

Certain effects also impact ground battles, such as the pulsar or hyperspace storm.
Compatibility
Can be added to new saves.CANNOT be removed from saves.FAQI don't like this specific effect. You're in luck. This mod has intense lunasetting and json support, meaning nearly everything is totally customizable.Where is all the customization? Most of it is in the MCTE_settings.json, so you can use the MCTE_reloadSettings command to reload them during combat.Does this mod affect AI battles? For the most part, no, but a few terrains such as the indevo minefield do.Where can I read about what a specific terrain effect does? MCTE has complete codex support; either go into the MCTE category via the codex, or press F2 while hovering over a terrain's campaign tooltip.
Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/MoreCombatTerrainEffects/releases
Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/MoreCombatTerrainEffects/tree/master
Buy me a ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/nikotheguydude

descriptionHtml:
More Combat Terrain Effects

About
This mod adds custom combat effect to most terrain that did not have an effect previously, as well as making campaign objectives useful in-combat.

Examples include...
  • Magnetic Field: Reduces weapon range, fighter range, jams guided missiles, and more.
  • Slipstream: Forces SO on all ships, fighters, and missiles. Yes, missiles.
  • Hyperspace Storm: Spawns nebula clouds that strike nearby ships with high EMP lightning. Very dangerous.
  • Sensor Array: Increases friendly fleet weapon range, depending on the fleet's distance to the sensor array.
More exist, and can be discovered in-game.

All effects follow the same rules (for the most part) as their campaign counterparts! Ex. hyperstorms strike you more often if you have a lot of mass or if you're moving fast. Conversely, moving slowly enough will prevent you from being struck at all.

Certain effects also impact ground battles, such as the pulsar or hyperspace storm.
Compatibility

Can be added to new saves.
CANNOT be removed from saves.
FAQ
I don't like this specific effect. You're in luck. This mod has intense lunasetting and json support, meaning nearly everything is totally customizable.
Where is all the customization? Most of it is in the MCTE_settings.json, so you can use the MCTE_reloadSettings command to reload them during combat.
Does this mod affect AI battles? For the most part, no, but a few terrains such as the indevo minefield do.
Where can I read about what a specific terrain effect does? MCTE has complete codex support; either go into the MCTE category via the codex, or press F2 while hovering over a terrain's campaign tooltip.

aiDescription: Adds custom combat effects to most terrain that did not have an effect previously, as well as making campaign objectives useful in-combat. Examples include Magnetic Fields that reduce weapon range and jam missiles, Slipstreams that force SO on all ships, and Hyperspace Storms that spawn dangerous nebula clouds. All effects follow the same rules as their campaign counterparts, and certain effects also impact ground battles.
